project.name: oais-structure-image
project.description: Opens an image described by its OAIS Representation Information -- a Representation Information manifest (see oais-structure-manifest) naming the data file, its DFDL/DRB SDF/Kaitai Struct descriptions and an image view -- and writes it as FITS, with its units and meaning in the header, for image viewers such as Fiji/ImageJ, SAOImage DS9 and Aladin. Decoding reuses oais-structure-topcat's RepInfoDecoder, so this module adds no dependencies of its own: FITS is written directly.
